meta.methodology: Each task score = weighted mean of available normalized 0-1 benchmarks (AA indices /100; GPQA/HLE/LiveCodeBench/AIME/Math-500/SciCode already 0-1; aider pass_rate /100). Sources merged via normalized provider+slug (AA dots->hyphens, reasoning-effort suffixes tolerated), then fuzzy name match. Only routing aliases (:batch/:free/:thinking) collapse in shortlists; identity tags (-latest, -0813, -v2) stay distinct.
